# Assess cross-border withholding before a payment

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

Before paying a foreign supplier, licensor, lender, contractor or related entity where tax treatment is uncertain. A documented adviser decision, verified payee information and authorized withholding or payment records.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

> Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Assemble the payment and counterparty facts

agent-runnable


Collect the contract, invoice, services or rights supplied, payer and payee entities, locations and proposed payment date. Confirm beneficial ownership and residency evidence requested by the adviser without inferring status from a mailing address.

- Sources: [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf) · [IRS recordkeeping](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/recordkeeping)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Determine the applicable treatment with local advisers

human · human approval required


Tax advisers assess source, payment character, domestic rules, treaty eligibility and required evidence for the actual payment. Leave missing documentation and conflicting positions unresolved; do not infer a universal rate or exemption.

- Sources: [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf) · [IRS recordkeeping](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/recordkeeping)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare the payment calculation and documentation pack

agent-runnable


Apply the approved treatment to the proposed amount and currency. Separate gross-up terms, tax withheld, net payment and reporting tasks, with the adviser decision and supporting forms attached privately.

- Sources: [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf) · [IRS recordkeeping](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/recordkeeping)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Approve payment and any authority remittance

human · human approval required


The designated approvers verify the payee, tax treatment and amounts before authorized operators release funds. Retain bank evidence and any separately required authority submission or remittance receipts.

- Sources: [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf) · [IRS recordkeeping](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/recordkeeping)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Reconcile certificates and reporting obligations

agent-runnable


Match settlement records to the ledger, deliver approved statements through the required channel and calendar reporting dates. Reassess the treatment when the contract, recipient or supporting evidence changes.

- Verify: A documented adviser decision, verified payee information and authorized withholding or payment records.
- Sources: [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf) · [IRS recordkeeping](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/recordkeeping)
